lines.en: I walk along the crystal light.
After half a day, my knees feel weak.
Where is the next meadow?
I could walk these midnight roads blind.

lines.zh: 午夜的石头，我闭眼也能绕。
lines.en: I can skirt the midnight stones blind.
My hooves cross the damp moss.
Grass grows slowly in endless night.

lines.zh: 走累了就啃两口午夜的草。
lines.en: Tired of walking, I nibble Midnight grass.

lines.zh: 永夜没有太阳，草也是灰的。
lines.en: No sun in the endless night; even grass is grey.

lines.zh: 午夜的暗里，我一步步盘过来。
lines.en: In the midnight dark, I coil in step by step.

lines.zh: 永夜里，我踩着自己的影子。
lines.en: In endless night, I tread my own shadow.
Midnight grass never looks quite right.

lines.zh: 永夜没有太阳，只有凉风。
lines.en: The endless night has no sun, only cold wind.
I remember every clump of grass.
This patch of grass has been trampled.

lines.zh: 午夜林地，走三步停一步。
lines.en: In the Midnight woods, three steps then a pause.

lines.zh: 午夜的树影里，我一动不动。
lines.en: In Midnight's tree shadows I stand still.

lines.zh: 午夜的风，吹得我毛直立。
lines.en: The Midnight wind lifts my fur.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里，慢慢伸展开。
lines.en: In the shadow, I slowly stretch out.
Something moves behind that tree.
I stare at a passing bug.
Chewing a grass root, I taste the soil in it.
My tail flicks a mosquito away.
The smell of moss is faint.
A little longer standing here is fine.

lines.zh: 鼻子对着风，什么都不想。
lines.en: Nose to the wind, thinking of nothing.

lines.zh: 午夜的风一吹，我就听见名字。
lines.en: The midnight wind carries names to me.
In Midnight soil, something crawls.

lines.zh: 午夜的空气尝起来像铁。
lines.en: Midnight air tastes like iron.
My tail wraps around me.

lines.zh: 午夜静得只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: The Midnight is so still, only my breath moves.

lines.zh: 这里的天，从来不是蓝的。
lines.en: The sky here is never blue.
I forget what I was chewing.
Two mouthfuls of grass, and all is well.
I crane my neck to look at you.
I step back and look at you again.
The light in your hand is in my eyes.
I watch the rift from the dark.
Don't go — I'm not done looking.
The Midnight's light is purple.
You smell of iron and sweat.
That lamp in your hand is too bright.

lines.zh: 永夜里的生物都不好惹。
lines.en: Nothing in this endless night is tame.
These antlers aren't decoration.
Your hands are empty — a pity.
Midnight moss is stuck to your soles.
My leg is numb and I can't stand steady.
Someone stepped on my tail.
No medicine in endless night; only pain.
Half a snarl rolls out of my throat.
Back off and let me breathe.

lines.zh: 午夜的空气太薄，我得缓一缓。
lines.en: The Midnight air is thin; I need a moment.

lines.zh: 午夜的毛，静电一样炸开。
lines.en: Midnight fur bristles like static.

lines.zh: 永夜里我不睡，你也别睡。
lines.en: I don't sleep in endless night; neither will you.
A dull ache spreads under my ribs.
Who struck me from behind?

lines.zh: 永夜里的东西，真舍得给我？
lines.en: You'd really give me something from the endless night?
The leaf is still wet with dew.
That sweet smell pulls me along.
My nose leans in before I can stop it.
Hold steady. My teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 有这口吃的，我能跑起来。
lines.en: With food like this, I can run.
You smell of fresh grass.
I walk close against your hand.

lines.zh: 午夜的光下，我的毛是暗的。
lines.en: Under the Midnight's light, my fur is dark.
Just one more leaf.
Don't take that tender shoot away.
Put it on the ground and I'll relax.
Wait for me, don't walk so fast.
Even midnight grass has a taste.
Keep walking — I'm right behind.
The eternal night's crystal shines on me.
I see stars from the bump.
I'm not a tree by the road.
Ow — you stepped on my forehoof.
My fur is still standing on end.
My shoulder is shoved aside.
That was just a brush, nothing more.
The knock has twisted my flank.
Never mind — not worth the fuss.
You knocked me swaying.
My steps slip on the moss.
Your coat shines in the light.
I keep my claws sheathed.
I have licked myself clean.

lines.zh: 我爪子里藏着一片软叶。
lines.en: I've a soft leaf hidden in my paw.

lines.zh: 我这几条短腿，跑得很稳。
lines.en: These short legs run surprisingly steady.
It's darker over there — come with me.
Antler to antler — that's a yes.
Let's stand side by side a while.

lines.zh: 我把收起来的爪子贴着你。
lines.en: I press my folded claws against you.

lines.zh: 夜里没有太阳，只有我们。
lines.en: No sun at night, only us.
I carry it in my mouth.
I nudge it twice with a hoof.
Is there anything else?
This shiny one goes back to my den.
It catches the light — I like it.
Whose is this, dropped here?
This one's for the young back home.
It smells a little odd.
I nudge it to my feet.
The night is long — I'll search slowly.
Back away, little ones — I'll handle this.

lines.zh: 永夜太黑，我靠味道找你。
lines.en: The night is black; I find you by scent.
One step closer and I charge.
Let me try one blow first.
That glowing grass is mine.
That shadow in the grass — hold still.

lines.zh: 食槽边上的东西，都是我的。
lines.en: Everything by my trough is mine.
I remember that last hit.
Don't move. I've got my eyes on you.
I plant my forehooves.

lines.zh: 这林子绕三圈，终点都是我。
lines.en: Loop this forest three times — every path ends with me.
I follow your hoofprints.
I'm already charging.
Under crystal light I see you clearly.
Once I catch you, I'm eating.
Your footsteps are coming closer.
My feet slip and I nearly fall.
I know this stretch of woods better than you.
I have four legs, you have two.
You keep turning — it's maddening.

lines.zh: 我的头很硬，撞墙也不怕。
lines.en: My head is hard enough to ram walls.
I lower my head and butt with my brow.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，蹄子砸在你身上。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs lands on you.
Take a head-butt from me.
My forehooves come up and slam down.
One bite at the back of your knee, and you won't run.
That one's for the kits in my den.
These horns stay pale even in the dark.

lines.zh: 午夜的裂缝，我守到今天。
lines.en: I've guarded this midnight crack till now.
In the dark, I bite first.
I step out of the night.
One step first, then another.
The first time I see this light.
I clear my throat.
I'm waiting here for my kin.
The crystal light stings my eyes.
Where am I? Is there grass here?
I came through the rift, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 又是新的一天，从哪开始。
lines.en: A new day, where do I start?
I open my eyes to a pale glow.
A patch of my coat is singed.

lines.zh: 我从石上摔下来，蹄子先着地。
lines.en: I fell off the stone and landed on my hooves.
This water is too deep to see the bottom.
Clods of dirt rain down on me.
The arrow shaft scraped past my ear bone.
A coldness seeps into my bones.
My stomach is hollow and jittery.

lines.zh: 电光把我的黑毛照白了。
lines.en: The flash turns my black fur white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有夜，也没有我。
lines.en: The void has no night, and no me.
